paper.title: Rapamycin, but not resveratrol or simvastatin, extends life span of genetically heterogeneous mice.

organism.source_quote: Rapamycin was administered in food to genetically heterogeneous mice from the age of 9 months and produced significant increases in life span, including maximum life span, at each of three test sites.

strain.source_quote: Rapamycin was administered in food to genetically heterogeneous mice from the age of 9 months and produced significant increases in life span, including maximum life span, at each of three test sites.

sex.source_quote: Median survival was extended by an average of 10% in males and 18% in females.
